hero.title: Góð afkoma,
hero.text: EBITDA stefnir í 441,5 m árið 2026, meira en tvöfalt 2025. En 90% krafna eru gjaldfallnar og sjóður gæti farið undir núll í þessari viku ef óbókaðar greiðslur hafa farið út.

top.title: Innheimta hjá þremur stærstu skuldurum
top.text: 365,0 m gjaldfallið. Lyftir lágpunkti sjóðs um 308,6 m.

top.title: Staðfesta óbókaðar greiðslur sep–okt
top.text: Laun, staðgreiðsla, VSK og afborganir, 123,5 m, ekki í bankabók. Sjóður líklega ofmetinn.

top.title: Kanna tvífærðan áfanga V-2601
top.text: SR00089 og SR00110, hvor 50,0 m án VSK, sama dag. Reikningsfært 41,0 m umfram framvindu.

top.title: Loka ársuppgjöri 2025 í BC
top.text: 168,1 m hagnaður 2025 ekki færður á eigið fé.

top.title: Reikningsfæra óreikningsfærða vinnu

hero.title: Strong results,
hero.text: EBITDA is heading for ISK 441.5m in 2026, more than double 2025. But 90% of receivables are overdue and cash could go below zero this week if unposted payments have gone out.

top.title: Collect from the three largest debtors
top.text: ISK 365.0m overdue. Lifts the cash low point by ISK 308.6m.

top.title: Confirm unposted payments Sep–Oct
top.text: Payroll, withholding tax, VAT and loan repayments, ISK 123.5m, not in the bank ledger. Cash is probably overstated.

top.title: Investigate double-billed milestone V-2601
top.text: SR00089 and SR00110, ISK 50.0m each excl. VAT, same day. Billed ISK 41.0m ahead of progress.

top.title: Close the 2025 year in BC
top.text: ISK 168.1m 2025 profit not transferred to equity.

top.title: Bill unbilled work
top.text: ISK 15.2m recoverable now: time jobs, mileage at ISK 0, hours above fixed fee.
